# ElevIQ Solutions

> ElevIQ Solutions helps businesses get ready for the agentic web through AI agent readiness audits and agentic web monetization strategy — practical AI consulting and integration services, based in France.

ElevIQ Solutions is run by Matthias Jung, founder. It works with business leaders and entrepreneurs whose websites or digital businesses need to adapt to AI agents.

## Services

- [AI Agent Readiness Audit & Optimization](https://eleviq.solutions/services/ai-agent-readiness.html): Test how effectively AI agents understand and act on your website, and get targeted improvements — from clearer content and structured data to agent-facing experiences.
- [Agentic Web Monetization Strategy](https://eleviq.solutions/services/agentic-web-monetization.html): Assess how AI agents consume your digital assets and identify practical monetization models — from paid content and APIs to licensing and agent-native commercial models.

## Contact

- [Book a free call](https://eleviq.solutions/booking/): 30-minute call to assess your situation and identify a concrete next step.
